game.title: BioShock 2 Remastered
game.blurb: First-person shooter with RPG elements, remastered by 2K (RAWG lists Digital Extremes, 2K Australia, 2K Marin, Virtuos, 2K China and Blind Squirrel), released 2016-09-15. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The journey through Rapture as a Big Daddy, milestone by milestone. All hidden on Steam, so spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Little Sisters and Big Daddies
chapters.summary: Adopting, protecting and dealing with Little Sisters, gathering ADAM and beating Big Daddies.

chapters.title: Plasmids, Tonics and Weapons
chapters.summary: Plasmid and Tonic slots, upgrading Plasmids, weapon upgrades at Power to the People stations, traps and vending machines.

chapters.title: Hacking and Research
chapters.summary: Hacking machines with the Hack Tool and researching enemies with the Research Camera.

chapters.title: Audio Diaries and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Collecting Audio Diaries, finishing on the hardest difficulty and finishing without Vita-Chambers.

chapters.title: Minerva's Den
chapters.summary: The Minerva's Den story: its Little Sisters, Vacuum Bots, a Lancer Big Daddy and its hidden milestones.

chapters.title: The Protector Trials
chapters.summary: Stars, ranks and ADAM collection in the Protector Trials.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 409720)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/BioShock_2
Fandom (bioshock.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://bioshock.fandom.com/wiki/BioShock_2
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Remaster: Steam app 409720 ("BioShock 2 Remastered" in the store list; the schema is named "BeachTree2", an internal codename) was used, not the 2010 original; RAWG keeps the original ("bioshock-2") and "BioShock 2: Minerva's Den Remastered" as separate entries. StrategyWiki redirects "BioShock 2 Remastered" to "BioShock 2" (completion stage 1), but it is not a usable guide: of the nine level pages on its contents list only "Pauper's Drop" is written (about 3,900 characters); Achievements and trophies, Controls, Enemies, Plasmids & Tonics and Table of Contents are the other written subpages, and the Walkthrough page itself is not written. So it was not used. bioshock.fandom.com answers the API under "BioShock 2", with about 154 linked articles (including "Minerva's Den (DLC)" and "The Protector Trials"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 23 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden and have no description. Five hidden ones (Login, Root Access Granted, SUDO, High Score, Logout) and the visible "Lancer Killer" sit in the Steam list next to the Minerva's Den achievements, so they were placed there by position; "Guardian Angel" sits among the Protector Trials achievements and was placed there. The other 17 hidden ones (Daddy's Home to Escape, plus Distance Hacker, Adopted a Little Sister, Unbreakable, Look at You Hacker, Counterattack, Savior and 9-Irony) sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder; some of those are likely hacking or Little Sister feats and need checking. The Steam schema spells one name "Enemy of the Familiy" (typo kept as given).
